A '''''Venator''-class Star Destroyer''' was attacked by forces from the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The Separatists landed a [[Separatist super-tank prototype/Legends|super tank]] on the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]], prompting [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Jet/Legends|Jet]] to send a [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|Jedi Knight]] to destroy the invasive [[Tank/Legends|tank]].
